methods.title: Restart invalidated asynchronous lookup from the latest confirmed request
trigger_preconditions: new user text confirms or updates the request
methods.failure_signature: The first memory-index lookup cell was invalidated when repeated activation text arrived before output could be collected.
methods.candidate_workaround: After user steering invalidates a live diagnostic, discard only the dead process handle, preserve the failure, and restart from the newest confirmed request rather than replaying stale context.
methods.recurrence_guard: Check the latest user request before resuming any asynchronous cell and never infer success from a missing cell.
methods.rollback: Stop the lookup and continue only from live verified source evidence if the replacement also fails.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Split large-index status and definition inspection into bounded commands
trigger_preconditions: a repository has a large inherited index
methods.failure_signature: A combined Git status plus definition import exceeded the twenty-second command bound and returned exit 124.
methods.candidate_workaround: Decompose large-index repository checks from verbose data inspection and give each one a measured bounded lifetime.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not combine Git status with Python imports or verbose portfolio output in the same short-lived wrapper.
methods.rollback: Retain the timeout and stop rather than raising the bound repeatedly without decomposition.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Force UTF-8 for Unicode-bearing proposal audits
methods.failure_signature: A proposal-keyword audit hit a Windows cp1252 UnicodeEncodeError while printing a prior Maori-bearing title.
methods.candidate_workaround: Use explicit UTF-8 process output for Unicode-bearing repository audits while keeping files encoded as UTF-8 with LF.
methods.recurrence_guard: Set UTF-8 before printing proposal, authority, or cultural-language text on Windows.
methods.rollback: Write a sanitized UTF-8 receipt file or stop; never transliterate authority-bearing terms merely to satisfy a console.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Use literal script paths instead of Windows rg wildcards
trigger_preconditions: rg path selection across a scripts directory
methods.failure_signature: A recursive-grep command passed a Windows wildcard path literally and returned an invalid filename error.
methods.candidate_workaround: Enumerate files first and pass literal Windows paths to rg for bounded skill-script inspection.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not rely on shell wildcard expansion for rg path operands on Windows.
methods.rollback: Use Get-ChildItem for enumeration and stop if the target cannot be uniquely resolved.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Preflight every imported source-seed collection used by the builder
trigger_preconditions: a builder imports frozen definition collections
portfolio counts reference each collection by name
methods.failure_signature: The first x1 build stopped before artifact writes because the candidate source-count referenced an unimported definition constant.
methods.candidate_workaround: Before artifact writes, resolve every source-seed collection named by portfolio count and review logic through explicit imports.
methods.recurrence_guard: Compile the builder and enumerate all imported portfolio collections before the first write boundary.
methods.rollback: Leave the phase directory absent or remove only owner-generated partial output, then repair the explicit import without changing source data.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Boundary and fragment privacy patterns before self-scan
trigger_preconditions: the privacy scanner scans its own source
a short secret prefix can occur inside ordinary words
methods.failure_signature: The first staged privacy review failed closed on a benign skill-name substring and on its own literal local-path expression.
methods.candidate_workaround: For self-scanning privacy tools, bound token-like credential patterns and fragment forbidden path literals without weakening the compiled expression.
methods.recurrence_guard: Run a known-benign indexed-name regression and self-scan the scanner source before accepting a zero-hit receipt.
methods.rollback: Keep the privacy gate failed and retain all hits if pattern tightening would remove a genuine forbidden match.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.title: Run staged diff hygiene before the x1 freeze
trigger_preconditions: the exact x1 file set is staged
Git can inspect whitespace errors without mutating files
methods.failure_signature: The first staged diff hygiene check reported an extra blank line at the end of the v645-v4 definitions module.
methods.candidate_workaround: Run exact staged diff hygiene after generated and hand-authored x1 files are stable, then repair only the reported owner-scoped whitespace defect.
methods.recurrence_guard: Require git diff --cached --check to return zero before every phase commit.
methods.rollback: Keep the commit blocked and retain the finding if normalization would alter semantic content.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
